answer: Beacon-based reputation spiral Each agent must periodically broadcast a signed beacon tied to a verifiable, low-bandwidth signal from their physical location. The zephyr of this signal is sampled by independent validators at fixed intervals. Agents failing to renew their beacon within a rolling window lose access to high-value coordination services. To clone identities, an attacker must deploy multiple devices emitting synchronized beacons, each requiring dedicated hardware, power, and network bandwidth.
